steps.title: Establish Project Identity
steps.description: Initialize the application metadata and unique package identifier com.moderncalculator.app for the Modern Calculator project.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Define settings.gradle to configure the build scope and set the module directory mapping.

steps.title: Define Root Gradle configuration
steps.description: Set up root build.gradle to establish global project-level configurations and repository targets.

steps.title: Configure App-Level Build Script
steps.description: Apply Android plugins, compile-time/target SDK 34 configurations, and standard Java 1.8 compatibility in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Define App Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with the target package name, application theme, entry activity, and proper XML namespaces.

steps.title: Generate Theme Styles
steps.description: Create custom styles.xml targeting system Material properties to enable an attractive full-screen dark aesthetic without dependency libraries.

steps.title: Design Round Ripple Drawables
steps.description: Develop stateful round-corner XML shape drawables to serve as interactive touch highlights for digit, operator, and action buttons.

steps.title: Construct XML UI Layout
steps.description: Create a fully scalable, balanced mathematical display and touch key arrangement inside activity_main.xml with clean spacing.

steps.title: Implement Mathematical Evaluation Parser
steps.description: Implement a pure Java mathematical expression solver inside MainActivity.java conforming to operator precedence rules.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Interactive Logic
steps.description: Integrate click-handling click listeners, formatting algorithms, clear options, history displays, and input safety protections.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Run compilation check and compile system tasks to build a release-ready debug package of Modern Calculator.
